inputs.name: audio
inputs.scale: audio * 10^(drive_db / 20), added back at the output

output: audio * 10^(drive_db / 20) + dense(h); 0 VU at 0 dB drive comes back at unity
gates: pytorch gru: rows r, z, n. r = sig(Wi_r in + bi_r + Wh_r h + bh_r); z = sig(Wi_z in + bi_z + Wh_z h + bh_z); n = tanh(Wi_n in + bi_n + r * (Wh_n h + bh_n)); h' = (1 - z) * n + z * h
